svg.title: How ca browser works
svg.desc: The agent runs the ca browser CLI, which talks to the native host over a same-user socket with mutual HMAC; the host relays to the extension's service worker by native messaging, and the extension dispatches DOM events in the agent's own tab, where a green pen with the owner's name shows the work, next to the user's own tab and pointer.

g.text: Your tab: your pointer, keys and focus
The agent's tab: DOM events, green pen
